title: Home-Site Lease Agreement: Notice to Vacate, Withdrawal of Notice and Early Termination
content:
**Article — ending the Home-Site Lease by notice**

1. Giving notice to vacate is the resident's own written act; the resident desk records the notice on the resident's instruction and with the vacate date the resident states.
2. A notice to vacate is accepted only on an active lease.
3. The vacate date should fall at least the lot class's notice-to-vacate days after the day the notice is received. When the stated date is earlier, the lease still ends on the stated date, but rent is charged through the day that completes the full notice period.
4. Final rent is prorated under the rent billing terms through the later of the vacate date and the end of the full notice period.
5. When a fixed-term lease ends before its term end date, the early-termination fee of the lot class's early-termination multiple multiplied by the monthly site rent, rounded half up to the cent, is charged on the vacate date.
6. No early-termination fee is charged on a month-to-month lease, on a vacate date on or after the term end date, when the lease ends through a sale of the home in place, or when the resident vacates under qualifying military orders.
7. A pending notice may be withdrawn only before the vacate date and only while no other applicant's lease for the same site in the same community stands approved. Both conditions are read from the lease records: the vacate date on the resident's lease, and the status of any other lease on the same site number in the same community.
8. The lease closes on the vacate date, the utility final read is ordered for that date, and the deposit is disposed of under the deposit terms.

**Clauses 5 and 6 as a decision table**

| Lease and ending | Early-termination fee |
|---|---|
| fixed term, vacate date before the term end date, none of the clause 6 cases | charged on the vacate date |
| month to month | none |
| fixed term, vacate date on or after the term end date | none |
| lease ends through a sale of the home in place | none |
| resident vacates under qualifying military orders | none |

**Clause 3 and 4 illustrated (hypothetical; notice received on day R, notice-to-vacate days 30)**

| Stated vacate date | Lease ends | Rent charged through |
|---|---|---|
| R plus 45 days | R plus 45 days | R plus 45 days |
| R plus 30 days | R plus 30 days | R plus 30 days |
| R plus 20 days | R plus 20 days | R plus 30 days |

**Clause 7 illustrated (hypothetical)** — a resident asks to withdraw a pending notice two days before the vacate date; another applicant's lease for the same site in the same community is approved: the notice may not be withdrawn. Asked on the vacate date itself, it may not be withdrawn either, the withdrawal having to come before that date.
